summary: copy_between(source_facade, source_path, dest_facade, dest_path, source_pipeline=None, destination_pipeline=None) — streams a file from one backend to another, optionally through separate read and write pipelines. Bridges two different StorageFacade instances (e.g. local → S3, S3 → GCS).
lifecycle_notes: source_pipeline= and destination_pipeline= are independent — allows decrypt-on-read + re-encrypt-on-write patterns
documentation_hooks: copy_between is the primary cross-backend transfer API — document the separate pipeline arguments for source/dest transforms
